summary: BEDSHELTER AS (org. no. 937 224 303) is a private limited company (AS) based in Nesbyen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2026-02-21. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 74.110 (Industri-, produkt- og motedesignvirksomhet); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Randi Torgersen; board chair: Randi Torgersen.
